responsibility: Implements GCC-specific extensions to rich_location for diagnostics that operate on trees and higher-level source constructs. It adds helpers for attaching expression ranges, misspelled-identifier replacement fix-its, indentation-aware formatted insertions, and type-mismatch labels, and it implements binary_op_rich_location heuristics that decide when to split a diagnostic across operator and operand subranges versus using one combined range, supplying richer source annotations to diagnostic.c and diagnostic-show-locus.c.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the gcc-rich-location pair: it defines the tree-aware helper methods, formatted fix-it insertion behavior, type-mismatch label text logic, and binary-operator range heuristics, whereas gcc-rich-location.h declares the gcc_rich_location classes and interfaces.
